name: Hour One
summary: Avatar video platform. The site no longer completes a TLS handshake.
description: Hour One turned scripts into presenter videos. On 21 October 2026, hourone.ai failed during the TLS handshake, so the Visit link does not open. Independent write-ups say Wix acquired the company in 2025 and the standalone app was discontinued. This pass did not read a vendor shutdown notice.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: No live pricing page. The previous Premium label was not rechecked.

features: Script-to-presenter video: Easily transform a written script into a professional video with a realistic AI presenter, reducing production time.
AI character library: Select from a wide range of digital humans to match your brand or audience demographics.
Integrations: Use via API or connect with learning management systems to automate large-scale video creation.
Multi-language support: Expand your training and onboarding reach with videos in multiple languages and accents.

howToUse.title: Create an Hour One Account
howToUse.description: Visit the Hour One website and register for an account. Verify your email to activate and access your dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Click 'New Project' and select your template (business, explainer, onboarding, etc.), or begin from scratch for custom presentations.

howToUse.title: Pick Your AI Presenter
howToUse.description: Browse the Hour One character library and choose an avatar that fits your project's tone, language, and audience.

howToUse.title: Write or Paste Script
howToUse.description: Write your script in the editor, or paste/import content from a document. Each slide/scene can have its own text.

howToUse.title: Voice & Language Selection
howToUse.description: Select from a variety of AI voices and languages for narration. You can localize content for different regions.

howToUse.title: Customize Scenes
howToUse.description: Change background images, add your own logos or graphics, and arrange elements for each video segment.

howToUse.title: Enhance with Media & Transitions
howToUse.description: Include images, video clips, animations, and smooth transitions to make your video more dynamic and engaging.

howToUse.title: Preview & Edit
howToUse.description: Preview the complete video, review presenter performance, and make changes to timing, visuals, or narration as needed.

howToUse.title: Export & Download
howToUse.description: Export your video in different resolutions (HD/4K with premium). Download as MP4 or get a shareable link.

howToUse.title: API & Bulk Automation (Advanced)
howToUse.description: Access Hour One's API and automation tools to generate videos at scale for e-learning, onboarding, or marketing campaigns.

statusNote: Official Wix press release (May 23 2025) on acquisition; web search (prizmad.com review, AI tool graveyard): standalone platform discontinued by Oct 2025, site unreachable
